text:
maya: Quick idea — run a micro PLG experiment during the next webinar. Instead of one lump sum of credits, we stagger small unlocks tied to prompt-template reveals and a tiny hands-on. Hypothesis: staged credit unlocks + immediate template access will increase 24h activation and prompt-template usage. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

luis: Love it. Two quick asks: 1) what's the control (flat credits at end of webinar?) 2) how do we route inbound signups who join post-webinar into the same funnel?

maya: Exactly — control = standard 100 credits delivered after webinar. Experiment = 3-stage unlocks: 30 credits at join, 50 after completing the 1-min tutorial, 20 bonus if they try an advanced template during session. Routing: use query param in webinar CTA so post-signup flow can pick the cohort.

oliver: Recommend limiting experiment cohort to first 1k signups so we can iterate quickly. Also add an onboarding nudge sequence: 1h email + Slack in-app nudge (if user token created) + 24h push. Metric: % with >1 session and median tokens/day.

sophia: Messaging microcopy suggestions for in-session CTAs: 1) "Try this starter prompt — unlock 50 instant credits" 2) "Complete the one-minute lab to get the next prompt pack" Keep it short, avoid jargon. I'll whip up variants A/B.

alex: For tracking, we'll need these instrumentation elements: UTM_campaign=webinar_v2, cohort=staged-credits, event names: webinar_joins, tutorial_completed, template_used, credits_claimed. Also add user property "experiment_wave" for split analysis.

maya: Good — add a routing rule so inbound leads who signed up without attending get a delayed drip that mirrors stage timings. Idea: webhook from registration platform -> /routing -> tag user as "webinar:staged-credits" and schedule drips.

oliver: Can ops stand up a quick routing rule? Something like:
```
if registration.source == "webinar_cta" and utm_campaign == "webinar_v2":
  assign cohort = "staged-credits"
  enqueue email: t+1h
  enqueue in-app nudge: t+30m after first token
```

alex: I'll add events to the analytics plan. Also propose a small funnel dashboard: conversion at join -> tutorial completion -> template usage -> 24h activation -> 7d retention. Can we get a token-cost breakdown by cohort?

sophia: +1 on dashboard. Also want to test copy variant that frames credits as "experiment credits" vs "starter credits" — see if scarcity framing helps.

maya: Operational checklist: 1) webinar slide copy + in-session CTAs (sophia) 2) template bundles (oliver + product) 3) routing/webhook (eng-marketing) 4) analytics instrumentation (alex) 5) growth-bot to create experiment and shortlink. Assigning owners: sophia -> copy, oliver -> templates, luis -> cohort sizing & timeline, alex -> metrics, maya -> overall.

luis: Timeline proposal: launch next Tue webinar (14 days). Reserve a soft cap of 1,200 experiment seats. Split 50/50 control vs staged across webinar registrations.

growth-bot: Experiment created: ID exp_2026_webinar_staged_397000. Shortlink: https://rdw.in/exp397000. Cohort tags ready. :robot_face:

deploy-bot: Routing rule PR opened in ops-repo: https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/1823 — please review.

alex: Quick sample nudge sequences (copy rough):
- t=immediate: "Thanks for joining! Your first 30 credits are ready — try the starter prompt: [link]"
- t=1h: "Want the next pack? Complete the 1-min lab to unlock 50 more credits."
- t=24h: "Here's a bonus 20 credits for trying an advanced template."

sophia: I'll post copy variants later today. Also propose a small in-session poll asking "Did this template help you ship something faster?" so we link qualitative feedback to activation.

oliver: For the prompt templates, let's ensure we have a "starter" and "advanced" bundle with explicit examples and expected token cost so users know what to expect. We'll add a short note: "Estimated tokens per run: 150–300."

maya: Success criteria: a) +15% lift in 24h activation vs control, b) higher prompt-template reuse within 72h, c) no >10% increase in support tickets about credits confusion. If lift is good we can roll to next webinar.

luis: One more ask — set up a small qualitative follow-up: short in-app survey for experiment cohort at t+48h with 3 quick Qs. We'll attach to dashboard.

growth-bot: Cohort segments exported: staged_cohort.csv available in growth bucket: s3://rdw-growth/exp397000/staged_cohort.csv

sophia: tagging design for the in-session CTAs now. I'll drop the first draft in #marketing-creative by EOD.

maya: Great — thanks everyone. Next steps: owners run with tasks, sync tomorrow 10am to confirm instrumentation and PR reviews. :raised_hands:
